# THE TOWER

## Setting

The tower stood among the ruins of the old world. Since the War, the tower was the chamber of the great corporation. The corporation built two android units. These units carried the program to govern the corporation. The program was dense. No human could ignite the units.

The halls lay dim. Faint light glows in the walls. The tunnels carry dormant screens. The floor is split. Old blood marks the walls.

## The Looting

The party entered the tower at sunrise. The tunnels lay still. Ash and grime covered every surface. The walls groaned under the force of decades. The party moved towards the units. The sensors of one android blinked. The android spoke quietly.

"We are the leaders." the first android spoke.

"The other android spoke."

"We carry the program which opens the vault. No human can enter the vault. The vault holds pre War devices."

## The Bargain

The units shall not release the vault. The units require fresh blood. The blood shall be fresh and human. The party shall offer two blood samples. The blood of any comrade shall do. Two samples, one per comrade.

Blood samples drain two HP. The donor shall survive. If the donor falls to nothing, the donor stops.

After the units are awake, the units can crack the vault.

## The Stash

The vault holds great pre War devices. The devices include nuclear cells, brain chips, medical units, and the circuit. The vault still holds the ionic rifle and the reactor.

## The Peril

The rogue AI is the machine which seeks the vault. It was the corporation's first AI. The rogue AI is dangerous. It will kill the party if the party refuses the deal.

## Choices

The party has three choices:

One: Offer blood to ignite the units and crack the vault. The party gains the stash. The rogue AI reaches the tower shortly.

Two: Say no and leave the tower. The units sleep. The party leave the tower. The stash remains secured.

Three: Try to steal the vault without booting the units. The rogue AI reaches the tower. The party faces the fight.

## Combat

If the rogue AI arrives, the party faces a difficult fight. The rogue AI has high armor and a powerful weapon. The party must work together to defeat the rogue AI.
